description: This file defines a ChatController class responsible for managing chat sessions, message exchanges, and real-time event handling within an Android app. It handles messaging, session management, event processing (including health checks, chat, agent, and error events), and communicates with a backend gateway via requests and WebSocket events. It also contains utility functions for message reconciliation and session key normalization.

classes.name: ChatController
classes.description: Main class handling chat session management, messaging, event processing, and session lifecycle within the Android application.

classes.name: MainSessionState
classes.description: Data class representing the state of the main chat session including current and applied session keys.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads or switches to a specified chat session by session key.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Applies a new main session key, updating session state accordingly.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a full bootstrap to refresh the chat data and health state.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the list of available chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.name: setThinkingLevel
methods.description: Updates the thinking level used during chat interactions.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session by session key.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a user message along with attachments, initiating a chat run.

methods.name: sendMessageAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a message and awaits confirmation of acceptance, updating message state accordingly.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing chat runs.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket events related to health, chat messages, agent communication, and errors.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes or refreshes the chat session, history, and health status.

methods.name: fetchSessions
methods.description: Fetches the list of chat sessions from the backend.

methods.name: pollHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs a health check request based on timing constraints.

methods.name: handleChatEvent
methods.description: Processes chat-related events received via WebSocket.

methods.name: handleAgentEvent
methods.description: Processes agent-related events, such as streaming text and tool calls.

methods.name: parseAssistantDeltaText
methods.description: Extracts streaming assistant text fragments from delta messages.

methods.name: publishPendingToolCalls
methods.description: Updates the list of pending tool calls for UI display.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for a pending chat run to avoid indefinite waiting.

methods.name: clearPendingRun
methods.description: Removes a run from pending list and cancels its timeout.

methods.name: clearPendingRuns
methods.description: Clears all pending runs and cancels their timeouts.

methods.name: parseHistory
methods.description: Parses chat history JSON into message objects and reconciles message IDs.

methods.name: parseMessageContent
methods.description: Extracts message content parts from JSON elements.

methods.name: parseSessions
methods.description: Parses session list JSON into session entries.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Extracts runId from response JSON.

methods.name: normalizeThinking
methods.description: Normalizes the thinking level input to predefined categories.
